rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Memorial Hospital joined MaineHealth as 12th member hospital effective January 1, 2018. First out-of-state hospital in network. Likely supported Moody's rating maintenance via implicit parent affiliation, though no formal credit substitution.

moodys._note: Presumed maintained post-MaineHealth affiliation; debt may have been refinanced into parent structure later

outcome_class_rationale: Baa3 Stable maintained. Affiliation with MaineHealth (stronger parent) likely supportive of credit, though formal rating uplift not surfaced. Critical Access Hospital designation provides reimbursement floor.

ma_events_2017_2018._note: Memorial joined MaineHealth effective Jan 1 2018 as 12th member, first out-of-state member. Strategic affiliation, not debt-financed acquisition.
